claim: My AI agent booked me 65 meetings in 7 days with 3-5 qualified meetings a day and zero manual work on LinkedIn.
why_it_matters: A skeptical small-business owner could replace an expensive SDR hire or manual outreach with an always-on system that generates pipeline without daily effort.
testable: Deploy a similar AI agent on LinkedIn for 7 days, track total meetings booked and qualified rate via calendar data, compare to prior manual baseline.

claim: In the last year, 100+ AI agents were built for Anthropic that replaced more than 400 employees.
why_it_matters: Shows AI agents can scale to enterprise-level workforce replacement, implying small teams could achieve outsized operational leverage.
testable: Audit internal agent deployments over 12 months, count headcount reduced or tasks automated versus employee equivalents via time-tracking logs.

claim: 1,000+ companies ran autonomously with AI handling engineering, marketing, and support every day.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates proven scale for small businesses to operate without constant human oversight, potentially cutting overhead dramatically.
testable: Run a comparable AI crew for 30 days, measure daily autonomous task completion rate and any revenue or cost savings versus prior manual ops.

claim: AI SDRs were supposed to replace sales teams but only 2% survived their first year, while human-crafted outreach still books meetings in 2026.
why_it_matters: Warns owners against overhyped tools that fail in practice, directing focus to proven hybrid methods for reliable pipeline.
testable: Track 10 AI SDR tools over 12 months for retention and meeting-booking rates, benchmark against human SDR performance metrics.

claim: Seed companies can now skip hiring their first SDR at $1.5M ARR because an AI agent handles lead triage, personalized replies, and booking calls.
why_it_matters: Enables leaner teams to maintain or grow pipeline without early headcount costs, freeing founder time for high-value work.
testable: Implement AI agent for inbound lead handling at a seed-stage company, compare pre/post ARR threshold for SDR hire and monthly meeting volume.

claim: Coldspur AI crew scrapes LinkedIn, sends/follows up on outreach, handles objections, and books demos priced per meeting booked with no ramp or overhead.
why_it_matters: Offers performance-based outbound without upfront SDR salary, letting small sales teams test volume at low risk.
testable: Activate the crew for 30 days, measure leads scraped, emails sent, meetings booked, and cost per meeting against manual or agency baseline.

claim: Sendio.ai books sales meetings for us on autopilot.
why_it_matters: Promotes hands-off pipeline generation for busy small teams that can't afford constant manual prospecting.
testable: Integrate the tool, run for 14 days, log all meetings booked automatically and attribute to the automation via source tracking.

claim: 45K+ agents created and 120K+ users already inside a platform where AI agents run on-chain executing tasks and rewarding owners.
why_it_matters: Indicates mature adoption of autonomous agents that could handle business ops like lead gen or follow-ups without constant management.
testable: Create and run an on-chain agent for a sales task over 7 days, measure task completion rate, rewards earned, and integration with CRM.
